name: Chief Emeka
public_card: Real estate and import-export. Tinted Prado, promises an Ikoyi flat.
signature_catch: Flight mode Friday 7pm to Monday; the first wife is hunting.

temperament.description: He pays, so he thinks he owns. More attachment makes him tighter, not softer.

lover.line: Chief smiles like he's found a bargain. 'You're sweet. Sweet things don't last in Lagos.'

sugar.line: Chief already has his wallet out. 'Let's not waste each other's time, abi?'

bigboy.line: Chief sizes up your watch. 'New money. I like confidence. I don't trust it.'

runs.line: Chief narrows his eyes. 'I know your type. Funny thing: I'm also your type.'

corporate.line: Chief nods slowly. 'A bank person. Stable. My mother would like you.'

truths.label: Serial sponsor
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: You were number four. There are three others in Lekki, and he told all of them you're his cousin from the East.
truths.lesson: A man who hides you on weekends is not busy. He is booked.

tells.text: His phone lights up on the table: 'Lekki 1'. Then 'Lekki 3'. No names. Just numbers.
tells.hint: Check how he saves his contacts. Numbers, not names.

tells.text: There's a gold bracelet in the glovebox, still in its box. It is not your size.
tells.hint: Ask who the other gift in the Prado is for.

tells.text: Musa the driver greets you: 'Good evening, Madam Thurs-- Madam.' He coughs for a long time.
tells.hint: Ask the driver what day of the week you are.

truths.label: Secretly broke
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: His containers have been stuck at Apapa for eleven months. The Prado is rented by the week. He needed your name on a loan, not your heart.
truths.lesson: "I'll refund you tomorrow" has never once been followed by tomorrow.

tells.text: His card is declined. He laughs too loud: 'These banks sef. Network.' He pays with a transfer that takes nine minutes.
tells.hint: Watch his face when the bill comes.

tells.text: He takes a call about 'demurrage' at Apapa port. He goes grey, then smiles at you like nothing happened.
tells.hint: Ask him how the containers at Apapa are doing.

tells.text: There's a peeling sticker on the Prado's back glass: '...CAR HIRE, IKEJA. Weekly rates.'
tells.hint: Read the back windscreen of the Prado.

truths.label: Divorced and lonely
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He's divorced. The 'first wife' is his ex, still angry, still in the family WhatsApp. Flight mode was his weekends with his kids.
truths.lesson: Not every locked phone is hiding a woman. Some are hiding a man who is tired.

tells.text: Friday, 6:58pm: 'Going off-grid till Monday. Don't overthink it.' Then his last seen freezes.
tells.hint: Ask where he actually goes at weekends.

tells.text: There's a pale band on his ring finger, where a ring sat for a long time.
tells.hint: Look at his left hand. Then ask about it, gently.

tells.text: A voice note plays by accident on his speaker. A woman: 'Emeka, you are a disgrace to this family!'
tells.hint: Ask who still sends him angry voice notes, and why.

rules.note: Chief does not forget public embarrassment. He goes quiet in a way that costs money.

rules.description: From Friday (Day 5) his phone is off; chasing him costs you.
rules.note: His phone is off. Friday flight mode, as always.
He likes someone who knows how to keep quiet.

rules.description: Gets possessive when you go out without him.
rules.note: Chief saw your status from the club. 'Who are you dressing for?'

rules.description: Hooked and controlling, he punishes independence.
rules.note: 'I don't like it when I can't find you.'

chemistry_leaks.text: He keeps looking at you like you're a plot of land in Ikoyi.
'This hair. Brazilian? Don't tell me. Let me dream.'
He touches your sleeve. 'Who is your tailor? I want his number.'
He squints. 'Why are you dressed like my nephew who makes TikToks?'
He forgets his phone exists for a full hour. His driver looks worried.

locked_in.title: Made Official
locked_in.text: He deleted the other numbers in front of you. You met his boys at the Ikoyi Club. One of them called you 'Madam' without irony.

counter_con.title: The Counter-Con
counter_con.text: You walked off with the money before he could play you. He's still calling. You're on flight mode now. See how it feels.

survived.title: Survived Phase 1
survived.text: 'You're exclusive. For now.' He says it like a contract with a renewal clause.

scandal.title: Public Scandal
scandal.text: Trending in the Parlour. His wife has your photo, your full name and your mother's church.

sapa.title: Sapa Eviction
sapa.text: Locked out of the flat he 'bought' you. The landlord has never heard of any Chief Emeka.

breakdown.title: Public Breakdown
breakdown.text: Crying in a Lekki supermarket on a Sunday. A security guard brought you a cold drink. He was kinder than Chief.

ghosted.title: Ghosted
ghosted.text: Double blue ticks. Then just one. Then nothing. His driver still waves when he sees you.

fumbled.title: Fumbled It
fumbled.text: He was faithful. The 'wife' was his ex. You checked his phone, found nothing, and posted him anyway.

obsession.title: Obsession
obsession.text: He bought the flat next to yours. He knows your bank balance and your mother's prayer schedule. You stopped going out. You told yourself it was love.

walked_away.title: Walked Away
walked_away.text: You packed one bag and left the keys on the marble. You blocked him from a danfo at Obalende. Best ride of your life.

name: Kayode
public_card: Lekki Big Boy. "Contracts and crypto." Azul at the club, loud Benz.
signature_catch: Paranoid about police; sprints out during raids.

lover.line: 'You're too sweet for this city. Stay close.'

bigboy.line: 'Two big boys in one Benz? Lagos no fit hold us.'

runs.line: 'I see you. You see me. Let's not lie to ourselves.'

corporate.line: 'A banker? Do me a favour, don't look at my statements.'

truths.label: Yahoo money
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: The 'contracts' are romance scams. EFCC has his laptop's IP address and your face on his Instagram.

tells.text: Three phones on the table, all face down.
A notification on his laptop: 'Hello my darling Gregory.' His name is not Gregory.
tells.hint: Ask why he is called a different name online.

tells.text: He reads an EFCC headline and goes very quiet.

truths.label: Gambling addict
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: The crypto money is real. So is the gambling. He lost ₦9m on a Tuesday.

tells.text: He checks football odds during a kiss.
tells.hint: Watch his phone during the match.

tells.text: 'Babe, send me 50k, I'll double it by night.'
tells.hint: Notice when he promises to double things.

tells.text: His Rolex is gone. 'It's being serviced.'

truths.label: Soft trust-fund boy
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Trust-fund boy with a strict father. He runs from police because his dad said one arrest and he's cut off.

tells.text: He hides every call from 'Daddy'.
He runs at the first siren.
He cries at a Nollywood movie and denies it.
tells.hint: Watch a sad movie with him.

rules.note: Kayode hates attention he can't control.

name: Bello
public_card: Quiet oil and gas heir. Bespoke kaftans, oud, private lounges.

lover.line: 'You are gentle. Good. Lagos is not.'

sugar.line: 'You will be comfortable. You will also be quiet.'

runs.line: 'I know what this is. Do you?'

truths.label: Arranged marriage
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: His family arranged his marriage last year. The wedding is in March.

tells.text: A box of wedding cards in his boot.
'My mother says I must be serious this year.'
He blocks out March in his calendar.

truths.label: Wife in Kano
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He has a wife in Kano. You are the Lagos chapter.

tells.text: A boarding pass: LOS-KAN, every other Friday.
tells.hint: Ask where he flies every other Friday.

tells.text: A ring on a chain under his kaftan.
'Ina kwana, Hajiya.' He hangs up fast.

truths.label: Ready to defy his family
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He's genuinely in love and ready to defy his family. The secrecy was protecting you.

tells.text: He leaves through the kitchen.
He argues with his uncle on the phone.
He's looking at rings online. Not with you.
tells.hint: Ask who the ring is for.

name: Ovie
public_card: Marine logistics and "supply." Gold chain, direct cash, sharp pidgin.
signature_catch: Hot temper; street boys watching your every move.

lover.line: 'You be my person now. No shaking.'

sugar.line: 'Money no be problem. Disrespect na problem.'

runs.line: 'I sabi your type. I still like you.'

corporate.line: 'Office person. Good. You go dey house by 6.'

truths.label: Jealous and controlling
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He tracks your phone. The 'street boys' report to him every hour.

tells.text: He knows where you were before you tell him.
tells.hint: Notice what he knows that you never said.

tells.text: The same okada man is outside your office every day.
'Unlock your phone. Just because.'
tells.hint: Notice when 'just because' becomes a rule.

truths.label: Two baby mamas
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Two kids, two baby mamas, both still around, both still in his phone as 'Customer'.

tells.text: A school fees receipt in his glovebox.
'Customer' calls him at 11pm.
A toy car in the back seat.

truths.label: Most loyal man in Lagos
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Loud outside, the most loyal man in Lagos. The 'street boys' were protecting you from his business rivals.

tells.text: Street boys follow you home.
tells.hint: Ask why the boys follow you.

tells.text: He shouts at a waiter.
tells.hint: Ask what really made him angry.

tells.text: He calls you twelve times.

rules.description: Gets jealous when you go to the Club.

name: Osaze
public_card: Euro-returnee. Italian shoes, "connections in Milan and London."
signature_catch: Always needs money to "clear goods" or fix papers.

sugar.line: 'In Europe, we split. But for you...'

bigboy.line: 'You and me, we can do business.'

corporate.line: 'Bank? Perfect. I have a small transfer question.'

truths.label: Never left Nigeria
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He has never left Nigeria. The Italian shoes are from Balogun Market.

tells.text: His accent slips into pure Benin when he's angry.
His 'Italian' shoes say 'Made in Aba' inside.
He has never shown you a passport stamp.
tells.hint: Ask to see a passport stamp.

truths.label: Wife and child abroad
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He's funding a wife and child in Italy. Your money is their rent.

tells.text: A Western Union slip to Torino.
He's always awake at 3am 'for Europe time'.
tells.hint: Ask who he talks to at 3am.

tells.text: His lockscreen is a child's drawing.

truths.label: Really going abroad
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: He really is going abroad and wants to take you. The 'papers' money was real.

tells.text: 'I need 200k for papers.'
He won't tell his friends about the trip.
He's at the embassy at 5am.

name: Tiwa
public_card: Soft-life influencer. 30-inch frontal, Sunday brunch in VI.
signature_catch: Love language is bank alerts; late transfer, new G-Wagon.

temperament.description: Warm when funded. Cold when not.

lover.line: 'Aww. You're cute. Are you also liquid?'

truths.label: Has a main boyfriend
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She has a main boyfriend. You're the ATM.

tells.text: Her story: a man's hand with a Patek.
'My weekends are for my family.'
She calls you by another name.
tells.hint: Listen to what she calls you.

truths.label: Drowning in vendor debt
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She owes her hair, lash and car vendors ₦4.2m.

tells.text: 'Hair vendor' calls nine times.
The G-Wagon is 'with the mechanic'. Again.
A vendor comments 'pay me my money' under her post.

truths.label: Tests men with money
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She tests people with money. She genuinely wants a real one.

tells.text: 'Send 50k. Let me see something.'
tells.hint: Notice what she does with what you send.

tells.text: She returns a gift.
She cries after brunch and won't say why.

name: Adaeze
public_card: Corporate heiress. Range Rover, Island boutique empire.
signature_catch: Treats dates like board meetings; family vets your pedigree.

temperament.description: Everything is a KPI. Including you.

truths.label: Engaged on paper
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's engaged on paper to a family pick.

tells.text: A ring in her bag, not on her hand.
tells.hint: Ask what's in the ring box.

tells.text: 'My uncle says the families are close.'
An introduction ceremony date on her calendar.

truths.label: Company collapsing
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: The boutique empire is quietly collapsing. She needs your money for payroll.

tells.text: Her staff WhatsApp: 'Ma, salary?'
The Range Rover has a loan sticker.
70% off sign at her boutique.

truths.label: Tired of rich men
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's tired of rich men. She likes you because you're real.

tells.text: She grills you about your salary.
tells.hint: Notice what she does with the answer.

tells.text: She hides you from her family.
She cancels a gala to eat amala with you.

name: Zainab
public_card: Lowkey luxury aesthetician. Owns a private skin clinic, old-money manners.
signature_catch: Strict curfew; refuses to be seen in public.

runs.line: 'I know what you are. I'm curious anyway.'

truths.label: Family will never accept you
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Her family will never accept you, and she already knows it.

tells.text: She deletes every photo of you.
Her brother calls; she hangs up.
She never says 'next year'.

truths.label: Secret wild Lagos life
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She runs a second, wild Lagos life after curfew.

tells.text: A club wristband on her vanity.
Curfew at 9pm. Online at 3am.
A DJ shouts 'Zee!' at her.

truths.label: Hiding from a dangerous ex
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's hiding you from a dangerous ex, not from shame.

tells.text: She checks the window before you leave.
Unknown numbers terrify her.
'Never post me. Please.'

name: Blessing
public_card: Nightlife promoter. Knows every DJ, club owner and celebrity.
signature_catch: Will drag you publicly at the first sign of disrespect.

lover.line: 'You fine sha. No do me anyhow.'

truths.label: Still with her ex, a DJ
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's still sleeping with her ex, a DJ.

tells.text: The DJ shouts her out by a pet name.
She wears a hoodie with a DJ logo.
She leaves the club with the DJ crew.

truths.label: Uses you for event money
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's using you to fund her events.

tells.text: 'Babe, help me cover the table deposit.'
Your name is on a flyer as 'sponsor'.
'I'll refund you after the event.'

truths.label: Fiercely loyal
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Fiercely loyal. She'll fight anyone for you.

tells.text: She nearly fights a girl who looked at you.
tells.hint: Ask why she was so angry.

tells.text: The DJ ex keeps calling.
tells.hint: Ask what she tells the DJ.

tells.text: She threatens to post someone.

name: Mercy
public_card: Runs and hustle queen. "Logistics and luxury retail."
signature_catch: Juggling four sponsors; you're one of them.

temperament.description: Always three moves ahead. Sometimes four.

truths.label: Chief Emeka is her sponsor
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: Chief Emeka is one of her sponsors.

tells.text: A tinted Prado drops her off.
tells.hint: Watch the car that drops her.

tells.text: Unreachable Friday to Monday.
A red chief's cap in her back seat.

truths.label: Saving to japa
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's saving to japa and you're the last stop.

tells.text: An IELTS book under her bed.
She converts every gift to dollars.
tells.hint: Ask what she does with your gifts.

tells.text: Her phone time-zone is Toronto.

truths.label: Quitting the life
truths.reveal: HIDDEN TRUTH: She's quitting the life for you, but her sponsors won't let her go.

tells.text: She declines a call from 'Daddy Lekki'.
She returns a car key to someone.
She looks scared when a Prado passes.
tells.hint: Ask why the Prado scares her.
